deadline.value: To be considered for an assistantship, apply by Jan. 1. International students wanting fall entry should apply by May 1, 2027, and for spring by Oct. 1.
deadline.quote: Students who want to be considered for an assistantship must therefore submit their application by Jan. 1

also.quote: International students should apply for the fall semester by May 1

gre_subject.value: The mathematics PhD page does not mention a GRE Mathematics subject test.

supervisor.value: A committee reviews every application; no named supervisor is required before admission.
supervisor.quote: All applications are reviewed by a committee with about a six-week wait for decision notification to applicants

funding.value: Assistantships are offered on a priority-deadline basis; the page does not promise funding to every admitted student.
funding.quote: For priority consideration for a graduate assistantship, apply by the program admission deadlines listed

entry_route.value: A master's or bachelor's degree in mathematics (with algebra and analysis coursework) is accepted.
entry_route.quote: Applicants should have a master’s degree or a bachelor’s degree in mathematics

notes: The Mathematics PhD is the only doctorate in the Department of Mathematics and Statistics; no statistics PhD was found in the catalog list.
